purpose: Blueprint for the public/customer-facing GitHub App that owns the ANPOS GitHub Marketplace listing and is used for Marketplace account reconciliation. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
permission_rule: Start with no repository/organization permissions beyond those genuinely required by approved customer-facing product capabilities. Add permissions only when a concrete feature requires them and re-review the Marketplace installation consent surface.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from the private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
Generate its private key only in GitHub and store it in an approved secret manager; never commit it.
Use a strong Marketplace webhook secret and verify webhook signatures before processing payloads.
Do not grant vendor private-template Administration permission to this customer-facing App.
Do not claim Marketplace publication, installation count, publisher verification, pricing, or free-plan value from this blueprint.
Re-check current GitHub Marketplace and GitHub App visibility requirements immediately before registration/listing submission.
